about: The smoke suite's groups and sizes in parallel jobs (.github/workflows/smoke.yml), each about 10 minutes on GitHub's runner: 8–11 in run 39898918235, with `tilefail` placed by its 86 s in run 39901539991. `button3d` (#226) has a job of its own, as it takes longer than one (16 minutes in run 39361708206). Every group and size is in exactly one job: .github/smoke_plan.py fails the run otherwise.
